answer:
**Login:** Name-only, no password. `LoginComponent.login()` (frontend\src\app\components\login\login.component.ts) calls `AuthService.login(username)` (frontend\src\app\services\auth.service.ts). It loads `localStorage` key `ai_dnd_user_<lowercase name>`, or creates a fresh `UserProfile{username, campaigns:[]}` if none exists, storing it there and in `ai_dnd_user` (the "active" profile, restored on reload).

**Campaigns storage:** Each campaign is a `CampaignSlot` (models\game.models.ts) — `{slotId, characterId, sessionId, characterName, class, race, level, lastPlayed, location}` — stored only in the browser's `localStorage` on the `UserProfile.campaigns` array (managed via `addCampaign`/`updateCampaign`/`removeCampaign` in `auth.service.ts`). The actual game state (character, inventory, session) lives server-side in Cloudflare D1 (`worker/migrations/0001_initial_schema.sql`), accessed via `worker/src/routes/character.ts` and `worker/src/services/character.ts`.

**On deleting a campaign slot:** `LoginComponent.deleteCampaign()` → `AuthService.removeCampaign(slotId)` just filters that slot out of the local `campaigns` array and re-persists to `localStorage`. No API call is made — the server-side character/session row in D1 is **not deleted**; it's simply orphaned (unreachable from the UI unless the user still knows the `sessionId`/`characterId`). This is explicitly called out in `auth.service.md`: "removeCampaign only deletes the slot. It doesn't delete the character on the server."
